entities.summary: Nikolas Tomas Stauskas is a Canadian former professional basketball player who played six seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA). A shooting guard, Stauskas played two seasons of college basketball for the Michigan Wolverines from 2012 to 2014. He was drafted eighth overall in the 2014 NBA draft by the Sacramento Kings. Stauskas, whose family is of Lithuanian heritage, is a member of the Canadian national team. Nik Stauskas was a athletes & competitors from Mississauga (b. 1993-10-07, Mississauga). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
